# Map Range

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Rescale a value from one range to another, linearly, on a log scale or a square root.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "map-range", "name": "map-range", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:inMin`, or read elsewhere as `ch('map-range/inMin')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `input` | `expr` | `"value"` |  |
| `name` | `string` | `"pscale"` |  |
| `kind` | `menu` | `"linear"` | `linear`, `log`, `sqrt` |
| `inMin` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `inMax` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `outMin` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `outMax` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `clamp` | `toggle` | `true` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->
